title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
廣西鄉試錄序
皇上神聖壽考紹
天闡極四十有三年而當甲子一
元之統蓋
基命萬年之首歷而陽德運行之
載始也易曰萬物出乎震震
東方也甲乙位焉子者孳也
===
陽氣倡化字養萬物也故孚
甲於甲孳萌於子仁澤滲液
乾元始亨大矣哉天行之周
也非
帝德之廣運其孰能與於此哉是
歲復當天下大比士之期函
夏之內道化磅礴純粹懿鑠
punctuated:
廣西鄉試錄序

皇上神聖壽考，紹天闡極四十有三年，而當甲子一元之統，蓋基命萬年之首歷，而陽德運行之載始也。《易》曰：「萬物出乎震。」震，東方也，甲乙位焉。子者，孳也，陽氣倡化，字養萬物也。故孚甲於甲，孳萌於子，仁澤滲液，乾元始亨。大矣哉，天行之周也！非帝德之廣運，其孰能與於此哉？是歲復當天下大比士之期，函夏之內，道化磅礴，純粹懿鑠
translation_en:
Preface to the Record of the Guangxi Provincial Examination

His Majesty, divinely sagacious and long-lived, has continued Heaven’s work and manifested the supreme standard for forty-three years. Now comes the jiazi year, which inaugurates a new cycle: the opening year of a calendar establishing the Mandate for ten thousand years, and a fresh beginning in the operation of yang potency. The Book of Changes says: “All things come forth in Zhen.” Zhen is the east, where the celestial stems jia and yi are situated. Zi means “to multiply”: yang energy initiates transformation, nurturing and nourishing all things. Thus things burst their seed casings at jia and multiply and sprout at zi; the blessings of benevolence seep everywhere, and the primal power of Qian begins to flourish. Great indeed is the full circuit of Heaven’s movement! Without the far-reaching operation of imperial virtue, who could participate in this?

This year also marks the appointed time for the great triennial examination of scholars throughout the realm. Within the Chinese domain, the transforming influence of the Way spreads boundlessly, pure and splendid …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
光明烏奕綴學之士飲醇和
而含景耀莫不奮迅淬礪思
一吐胷中之蘊熈
大猷萬分之一也先是臺臣言
選舉法行久士習刓敝四方
所貢或間以非人不稱求賢
審官之典願有以釐飭之也
===
上下其章禮部議以為
國家規萬世之安定舉士之法
至密也奉而行之存乎其人
奉法不至訾議乃興而法非
不具也請
勅御史謹察執事之不如法者士
湛溺浮偽之習文肆而用寡
punctuated:
光明烏奕。綴學之士，飲醇和而含景耀，莫不奮迅淬礪，思一吐胷中之蘊，熈大猷萬分之一也。先是，臺臣言：「選舉法行久，士習刓敝，四方所貢，或間以非人，不稱求賢審官之典，願有以釐飭之也。」
上下其章，禮部議以為：「國家規萬世之安，定舉士之法至密也。奉而行之，存乎其人。奉法不至，訾議乃興，而法非不具也。請勅御史謹察執事之不如法者。士湛溺浮偽之習，文肆而用寡，
translation_en:
…bright and resplendent [?]. Scholars pursuing their studies imbibed this pure harmony and absorbed its radiant brilliance. All roused themselves and honed their abilities, hoping to give expression to the learning stored within their breasts and thereby contribute even one ten-thousandth part to the flourishing of the grand imperial plan. Previously, a censorial official had stated: “The regulations for selecting men for office have long been in force, but scholars’ practices have deteriorated. Among those recommended from the various regions, unsuitable men are sometimes included. This does not accord with the established principles of seeking worthy men and scrutinizing candidates for office. I hope that measures may be taken to rectify this.”
The Emperor referred his memorial to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation. The ministry stated: “In planning for the peace of ten thousand generations, the state has established exceedingly meticulous regulations for selecting scholars. Their observance and implementation depend upon the men entrusted with them. When the regulations are inadequately observed, criticism arises; it is not that the regulations themselves are deficient. We request that the Emperor instruct the censor-investigators to scrutinize carefully those administering these affairs who fail to act according to the regulations. Scholars are sunk in habits of superficiality and falsity; their writing is unrestrained, yet of little practical use…”

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
宜令督學憲臣汰凡冗簡茂
士以應有司之求諸俶詭淫
靡之詞不得與推擇則可以
得真才裨
聖化他率舉正如故事
詔曰可方是時監察御史黃泮祗
命闕下代前御史曾承芳巡按廣
===
西親奉
德音嚴駕載馳不遑寧處至則届
期矣執憲塞違加嚴常歲維
時提督兩廣軍務兵部右侍
郎兼右僉都御史吳桂芳秉
鉞有虔廓清大憝嶺海既乂
文教誕敷總兵官恭順侯吳
punctuated:
宜令督學憲臣汰凡冗，簡茂士，以應有司之求。諸俶詭淫靡之詞，不得與推擇，則可以得真才，裨聖化。他率舉正，如故事。
詔曰：「可。」方是時，監察御史黃泮祗命闕下，代前御史曾承芳巡按廣西，親奉德音，嚴駕載馳，不遑寧處。至則届期矣，執憲塞違，加嚴常歲。維時，提督兩廣軍務兵部右侍郎兼右僉都御史吳桂芳秉鉞有虔，廓清大憝。嶺海既乂，文教誕敷。總兵官恭順侯吳
translation_en:
…The censorial officials supervising education should be ordered to weed out the mediocre and superfluous and select outstanding scholars to meet the requirements of the responsible authorities. Those whose writings are bizarre, extravagant, or ornate should not be eligible for recommendation and selection. In this way, genuine talent may be obtained to assist the sage ruler’s civilizing influence. All other matters should be duly regulated according to established precedent.
The Emperor’s decree reads: “Approved.” At this time, Investigating Censor Huang Pan respectfully received his orders at the imperial court to replace the previous censor, Zeng Chengfang, as Regional Inspector of Guangxi. Having personally received the imperial pronouncement, he readied his carriage and hastened on his journey, allowing himself no rest. By the time he arrived, the examination date was already at hand. He enforced the regulations and prevented infractions with greater strictness than in ordinary years.
At that time, Wu Guifang, Supreme Commander of Military Affairs in Guangdong and Guangxi, Right Vice Minister of War, and concurrently Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, wielded his military authority with reverent diligence and swept away the great malefactors. With the Lingnan and coastal regions pacified, literary learning and moral instruction spread widely. The Regional Commander, the Marquis of Gongshun, Wu…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
繼爵共建洪伐靖寇寧人以
故八桂之士得摶心壹志居
業以待問乃以前巡按御史
顧曾唯先期禮聘衮及教授
韓以孚為考試官教授林大
亨教諭何所聞陳士介余光
裕成果陳舜卿為同考試官
===
提調則右布政使許應元左
參政陳其樂監試則按察使
陳典副使蔡文及諸執事三
肅而申儆焉於是進提學副
使何寛所取士一千三百人
試之得五十有五人錄其文
以
punctuated:
繼爵共建洪伐，靖寇寧人。以故八桂之士得摶心壹志，居業以待問。乃以前巡按御史顧曾唯先期禮聘衮及教授韓以孚為考試官，教授林大亨、教諭何所聞、陳士介、余光裕、成果、陳舜卿為同考試官。

提調則右布政使許應元、左參政陳其樂，監試則按察使陳典、副使蔡文，及諸執事，三肅而申儆焉。於是進提學副使何寛所取士一千三百人，試之，得五十有五人，錄其文以
translation_en:
…Jijue together achieved great merit, suppressing bandits and bringing peace to the people. Thus the scholars of Bagui (Guangxi) were able to concentrate their minds and unite their purpose, pursuing their studies in preparation for examination. The former Regional Inspector, Gu Zengwei, had formally invited Gun and Prefectural School Instructor Han Yifu in advance to serve as Examiners, and Prefectural School Instructor Lin Daheng and County School Instructors He Suowen, Chen Shijie, Yu Guangyu, Cheng Guo, and Chen Shunqing to serve as Associate Examiners.

The Proctors were Right Provincial Administration Commissioner Xu Yingyuan and Left Administration Vice Commissioner Chen Qile. Overseeing the examination were Provincial Surveillance Commissioner Chen Dian and Surveillance Vice Commissioner Cai Wen. Together with the various functionaries, they repeatedly observed solemn formalities and renewed their admonitions. Thereupon the 1,300 scholars selected by Education Intendant He Kuan, a Surveillance Vice Commissioner, were admitted and examined. Fifty-five were selected, and their essays were recorded in order to…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
獻袞旣卒業而後得竊窺我
明文德之炳燿至於斯而莫可
加也已是豈不足以彰
聖天子久道作人之驗哉夫
明詔一曰下而萬里裔徼之士無
不丕應傒志納於軌則之內
者讀其文畔乎道者鮮矣其
===
粹然而得雋者皆明體而可
適之用者也則豈一朝一夕
之及哉惟昔唐虞之際十六
族遞興而在野順則比屋可
封其在有周思皇多士生於
王國而中林兔罝之人亦肅
肅有禮是三聖人者皆期願
punctuated: 獻。袞旣卒業，而後得竊窺我明文德之炳燿，至於斯而莫可加也已。是豈不足以彰聖天子久道作人之驗哉？夫明詔一曰下，而萬里裔徼之士無不丕應，傒志納於軌則之內者。讀其文，畔乎道者鮮矣。其粹然而得雋者，皆明體而可適之用者也，則豈一朝一夕之及哉？惟昔唐虞之際，十六族遞興，而在野順則，比屋可封。其在有周，思皇多士，生於王國，而中林兔罝之人亦肅肅有禮。是三聖人者，皆期願
translation_en:
…to present them. Only after finishing my reading did I, Gun 袞, gain a glimpse of the brilliance of our Ming dynasty’s civil virtue: it has reached a height beyond which nothing can be added. Is this not sufficient to demonstrate the efficacy of the sagely Son of Heaven’s enduring cultivation of men of talent? Once the imperial edict was issued [?], scholars at the distant frontiers, ten thousand li away, all responded wholeheartedly, directing their aspirations toward conformity with the established standards. Reading their compositions, one finds few that depart from the Way. Those whose purity and refinement won them distinction all understand the underlying substance and can apply it in practice. How could this have been achieved in a single morning or evening?

Long ago, in the age of Tang and Yu, the sixteen lineages rose in succession; those outside office followed the proper standards, so that every household had someone worthy of enfeoffment. Under the Zhou, the many illustrious scholars were born within the royal realm, while even those who set rabbit nets in the woods were reverent and observant of ritual propriety. These three sages all hoped and wished [?]…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
在位當時之士被風濡教游
泳涵潤之漸非一歲之積固
宜得人之多寥廓千載而鮮
繼也然方之于
今則恧矣何者分北三苗則聲
教所曁猶有遺也荆蠻來威
則江介以南政弗及也豈若
今日道德之澤仁義之紀遐邇
同風匝洽無外乎然則振古
以來於斯爲盛矣雖然臺察
之讜言禮臣之竤議不可不
深長思也夫求士於藝文由
中世以降莫之能變矣而文
果足以盡士乎哉自夫子稱
punctuated:
在位。當時之士，被風濡教，游泳涵潤之漸，非一歲之積，固宜得人之多，寥廓千載而鮮繼也。然方之于今，則恧矣。何者？分北三苗，則聲教所曁猶有遺也；荆蠻來威，則江介以南，政弗及也。豈若今日道德之澤、仁義之紀，遐邇同風，匝洽無外乎？然則振古以來，於斯爲盛矣。
雖然，臺察之讜言、禮臣之竤議，不可不深長思也。夫求士於藝文，由中世以降，莫之能變矣。而文果足以盡士乎哉？自夫子稱
translation_en:
…held office. The scholars of that time received the transforming influence and were steeped in instruction; their gradual immersion and nourishment had accumulated over more than a single year. It was therefore fitting that so many worthy men were found—a success seldom matched across the vast span of a thousand years. Yet compared with the present, those times must feel ashamed. Why? When the Sanmiao were divided and banished, there were still places beyond the reach of civilizing instruction; when the Jing barbarians came to submit to the royal majesty, government did not extend south of the Yangzi’s banks. How could this compare with today, when the beneficence of the Way and virtue, and the guiding principles of benevolence and righteousness, bring distant and nearby places alike under the same transforming influence, reaching everywhere and leaving none outside? Thus, from remotest antiquity to the present, flourishing has reached its height in our time.
Nevertheless, we must reflect deeply and at length upon the forthright words of the censors and the broad deliberations of the officials of the Ministry of Rites. Selecting scholars through literary composition has been a practice that no one has been able to change since the middle period of antiquity. But can writing truly reveal all that there is to a scholar? Since the Master said…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
文莫由人躬行未得論篤是
與非必君子而子夏大賢也
猶曰出見紛華盛麗而悅入
聞道義之言而樂何則感於
物而動人之情也發乎情止
乎禮義惟賢者能之今袞之
所得乎多士者洋洋纚纚溢
===
===
眥滿志信道義之言已雖多
士資以自獻其身而成信者
固曰篤於論而文之者也君
子色莊袞其知乎哉夫持難
知之論以求易感之情袞之
所不敢必也有如一曰怵於
紛華不成其信則主司有遺
punctuated: 文莫由人，躬行未得，論篤是與，非必君子。而子夏大賢也，猶曰：「出見紛華盛麗而悅，入聞道義之言而樂。」何則？感於物而動，人之情也；發乎情，止乎禮義，惟賢者能之。今袞之所得乎多士者，洋洋纚纚，溢眥滿志，信道義之言已。雖多士資以自獻其身，而成信者，固曰篤於論而文之者也。君子、色莊，袞其知乎哉？夫持難知之論，以求易感之情，袞之所不敢必也。有如一曰怵於紛華，不成其信，則主司有遺
translation_en: …in literary accomplishment, comparable to others [?], yet not having attained excellence in personal conduct; approving someone for earnest discourse does not necessarily establish that he is a gentleman. Even Zixia, a great worthy, said: “Going out, I see dazzling splendor and magnificence and am pleased; returning within, I hear words of the Way and righteousness and am delighted.” Why is this? To be moved by encounters with external things is human nature. Only the worthy can let feelings arise yet keep them within the bounds of ritual propriety and righteousness. Now the writings I, Gun, have obtained from these many scholars are abundant and flowing, filling my eyes and satisfying my aspirations. They are indeed words of the Way and righteousness. Yet although these scholars use them to present themselves, those who thereby establish their credibility are, admittedly, earnest in their discourse and give it literary expression. Whether they are gentlemen or merely solemn in appearance—can I, Gun, know? To take discourse whose sincerity is difficult to ascertain and use it to discern feelings so easily swayed is something of which I dare not be certain. Should they one day [?] be enticed by dazzling splendor and fail to live up to that credibility, then the presiding examiners would be left with …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
罪而士有餘詬此衮之所爲
過計者也夫士之自待未甞
薄也亮采之佐浚明之臣翊
成
昭代之治非乏於曩時也而衮
則過爲之計者誠以
聖天子神化之浹廣於唐虞有周
===
之世而士之効用也曾無師
師濟濟之衆至乃屢騰臣工
申飭之請上厪
宵旰仄席之思則舛矣孟子曰
待文王而興者凡民也况於
聖上軼三登五而望
清光之士猶有待於勸厲此不
punctuated: 罪，而士有餘詬，此衮之所爲過計者也。夫士之自待未甞薄也，亮采之佐、浚明之臣，翊成昭代之治，非乏於曩時也。而衮則過爲之計者，誠以聖天子神化之浹，廣於唐虞有周之世，而士之効用也，曾無師師濟濟之衆，至乃屢騰臣工申飭之請，上厪宵旰仄席之思，則舛矣。孟子曰：「待文王而興者，凡民也。」况於聖上軼三登五，而望清光之士猶有待於勸厲，此不
translation_en: …blame, while the scholars incur still greater reproach. This is what leads me, Gun, to be excessively concerned. Scholars have never set low expectations for themselves. Assistants who faithfully discharge their duties and ministers of profound discernment, helping to bring about the good government of this illustrious age, are no scarcer than in former times. Yet I am excessively concerned because the sage Son of Heaven’s transforming influence reaches more widely than it did in the ages of Tang Yao, Yu Shun, and the Zhou. Nevertheless, among scholars rendering service, there is not even a numerous company working harmoniously together. Matters have reached the point that officials repeatedly submit requests for renewed admonitions, troubling His Majesty above and causing him to rise before dawn, eat late, and sit uneasily in anxious thought. This is surely amiss. Mencius said: “Those who await King Wen before being stirred to action are ordinary people.” How much more so when our sage sovereign surpasses the Three Sovereigns and ranks with the Five Emperors, yet scholars who look upon his pure radiance still await encouragement and exhortation! This cannot…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
可以不深長思者也是舉也
右參政黎民表劉子興副使
李慎僉事朱安期陳一松協
恭綜理庶事允釐鎭守廣西
副總兵王寵攄猷折衝兩江
晏謐署都指揮僉事袁魯督
察徼巡內外以肅副使成子
===
學右參議姚世熈與議始圖
至是則已入賀
萬壽矣法得竝書
浙江紹興府儒學教授劉衮
謹序
punctuated:
可以不深長思者也。是舉也，右參政黎民表、劉子興，副使李慎，僉事朱安期、陳一松，協恭綜理，庶事允釐。鎭守廣西副總兵王寵，攄猷折衝，兩江晏謐。署都指揮僉事袁魯，督察徼巡，內外以肅。副使成子學、右參議姚世熈，與議始圖，至是則已入賀萬壽矣，法得竝書。
浙江紹興府儒學教授劉衮謹序。
translation_en:
…cannot but be pondered deeply and at length. For this examination, Right Administration Vice Commissioners Li Minbiao and Liu Zixing, Surveillance Vice Commissioner Li Shen, and Assistant Surveillance Commissioners Zhu Anqi and Chen Yisong worked together respectfully to oversee affairs, ensuring that every matter was properly managed. Wang Chong, Vice Regional Commander stationed in Guangxi, exercised strategic judgment and warded off threats, keeping the Two Rivers region peaceful. Yuan Lu, acting Assistant Regional Military Commissioner, supervised inspections and patrols, maintaining order both within and without. Surveillance Vice Commissioner Cheng Zixue and Right Administration Assistant Commissioner Yao Shixi participated in the initial deliberations and planning; by this time, however, they had already gone to court to offer congratulations on the emperor’s birthday. In accordance with convention, their names may be recorded alongside the others.
Preface respectfully written by Liu Gun, Professor of the Confucian School of Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang.

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試
監臨官
巡按廣西監察御史黃泮〔魯在福建龍溪縣人癸丑進士〕
提調官
廣西等處承宣布政使司右布政使許應元〔子春浙江錢塘縣籍順天府東安縣人壬辰進士〕
廣西等處承宣布政使司左參政陳其樂〔惟和江西貴溪縣人辛丑進士〕
監試官
廣西等處提刑按察司按察使陳典〔子厚保定中衛中所官籍庚戌進士〕
廣西等處提刑按察司副使蔡文〔孚中福建南靖縣籍龍溪縣人癸未進士〕
===
考試官
浙江紹興府儒學教授劉衮〔思補直隸鹽城縣人戊子貢士〕
湖廣武昌府儒學教授韓以孚〔在中河南汝陽縣籍直隸吳縣人癸卯貢士〕
同考試官
江西九江府儒學教授林大亨〔時嘉貴州前衛籍浙江錢塘縣人乙卯貢士〕

Guangxi Provincial Examination, forty-third year of Jiajing (1564).

Supervising Official
Huang Pan, Regional Inspector of Guangxi and Investigating Censor, had the courtesy name Luzai. He was from Longxi County, Fujian, and was a metropolitan graduate (jinshi) of the guichou year.

Proctors
Xu Yingyuan, Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Guangxi, had the courtesy name Zichun. He was registered in Qiantang County, Zhejiang, and was from Dong’an County, Shuntian Prefecture. He was a metropolitan graduate of the renchen year.
Chen Qile, Left Administration Vice Commissioner of Guangxi, had the courtesy name Weihe. He was from Guixi County, Jiangxi, and was a metropolitan graduate of the xinchou year.

Examination Monitoring Officials
Chen Dian, Surveillance Commissioner of Guangxi, had the courtesy name Zihou. He held official-household registration in the Central Battalion of the Baoding Central Guard and was a metropolitan graduate of the gengxu year.
Cai Wen, Surveillance Vice Commissioner of Guangxi, had the courtesy name Fuzhong. He was registered in Nanjing County, Fujian, and was from Longxi County. He was a metropolitan graduate of the guiwei year.

Examiners
Liu Gun, Instructor in the Confucian School of Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, had the courtesy name Sibu. He was from Yancheng County, Zhili, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the wuzi year.
Han Yifu, Instructor in the Confucian School of Wuchang Prefecture, Huguang, had the courtesy name Zaizhong. He was registered in Ruyang County, Henan, and was from Wu County, Zhili. He was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the guimao year.

Associate Examiners
Lin Daheng, Instructor in the Confucian School of Jiujiang Prefecture, Jiangxi, had the courtesy name Shijia. He was registered in the Guizhou Front Guard and was from Qiantang County, Zhejiang. He was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the yimao year.
He Suowen, Instructor in the Confucian School of Wuyuan County, Huizhou Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Xizhao. He was from Shunde County, Guangdong, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the dingyou year.
Chen Shijie, Instructor in the Confucian School of Zhangpu County, Zhangzhou Prefecture, Fujian, had the courtesy name Chouxian. He was from Nanhai County, Guangdong, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the dingyou year.
Yu Guangyu, Instructor in the Confucian School of Huaining County, Anqing Prefecture, Zhili, had the courtesy name Wuke. He was from Shunde County, Guangdong, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the yimao year.
Cheng Guo, Instructor in the Confucian School of Xiaoshan County, Shaoxing Prefecture, Zhejiang, had the courtesy name Yingyang. He was from Yancheng County, Zhili, and was a tribute scholar (gongshi) of the yimao year.

translation_en:

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
第壹場
四書
如或知爾則何以哉
可以賛天地之化育則可以與天地參矣
欲爲臣盡臣道
易
聖人以神道設教而天下服矣
允升大吉上合志也
是興神物以前民用聖人以此齋戒以神
===
明其德夫
百官以治萬民以察
書
皇天眷命奄有四海爲天下君
山川鬼神亦莫不寧曁鳥獸魚鼈咸若
會其有極歸其有極曰皇極之敷言是彛
是訓于帝其訓凡厥庶民極之敷言是
訓是行以近天子之光
推賢讓能庶官乃和
punctuated:
第壹場

四書
如或知爾，則何以哉？
可以賛天地之化育，則可以與天地參矣。
欲爲臣，盡臣道。

易
聖人以神道設教，而天下服矣。
允升，大吉，上合志也。
是興神物，以前民用，聖人以此齋戒，以神明其德夫！
百官以治，萬民以察。

書
皇天眷命，奄有四海，爲天下君。
山川鬼神，亦莫不寧，曁鳥獸魚鼈咸若。
會其有極，歸其有極。曰：「皇極之敷言，是彛是訓，于帝其訓。」凡厥庶民，極之敷言，是訓是行，以近天子之光。
推賢讓能，庶官乃和。
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books
If someone were to recognize your abilities, what would you do?
If one can assist in the transforming and nourishing work of Heaven and Earth, one can form a triad with Heaven and Earth.
If you wish to serve as a minister, fulfill the Way of a minister.

Book of Changes
The sage establishes instruction through the spiritual Way, and all under Heaven submit.
“Advancing upward with confidence: great good fortune.” This is because one’s aims accord with those above.
Thus they brought forth numinous objects to guide the people’s use of them. Through these, the sages purified themselves and observed abstinence, thereby making their virtue spiritually luminous!
Through this, the hundred officials were brought into good order, and the myriad people were kept under scrutiny.

Book of Documents
August Heaven bestowed its favor and mandate upon him; he possessed all within the Four Seas and became ruler of all under Heaven.
The spirits of mountains and rivers were all at peace, and birds, beasts, fish, and turtles likewise all followed their proper course.
Gather toward the norm; return to the norm. Say: “The fully expounded words of the August Norm are the constant rule and instruction; they are instruction from the Supreme Lord.” Let all the common people take the fully expounded words of the norm as their instruction and put them into practice, thereby drawing near to the radiance of the Son of Heaven.
Advance the worthy and yield to the capable; then the various officials will be in harmony.

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
詩
稱彼兕觥萬壽無疆
征伐玁狁蠻荆來威
倬彼雲漢爲章于天周王壽考遐不作人
追琢其章金玉其相勉勉我王綱紀四
方
懷柔百神及河喬嶽
春秋
秋九月齊侯宋公江人黃人盟于貫〔僖公〕
===
〔二年〕
九月晉侯宋公衛侯鄭伯曹伯會于扈晉
荀林父帥師伐陳〔宣公九年〕
秋七月齊侯使國佐如師己酉及國佐盟
于袁婁〔成公二年〕夏公會齊侯于夾谷
公至自夾谷齊人來歸鄆讙龜陰田
〔俱定公十年〕
夏叔孫豹會晉趙武楚屈建蔡公孫歸生
衛石惡陳孔奐鄭良霄許人曹人于宋
punctuated:
詩
稱彼兕觥，萬壽無疆。
征伐玁狁，蠻荆來威。
倬彼雲漢，爲章于天。周王壽考，遐不作人？
追琢其章，金玉其相。勉勉我王，綱紀四方。
懷柔百神，及河喬嶽。

春秋
秋九月，齊侯、宋公、江人、黃人盟于貫。〔僖公〕〔二年〕
九月，晉侯、宋公、衛侯、鄭伯、曹伯會于扈。晉荀林父帥師伐陳。〔宣公九年〕
秋七月，齊侯使國佐如師。己酉，及國佐盟于袁婁。〔成公二年〕夏，公會齊侯于夾谷。公至自夾谷。齊人來歸鄆、讙、龜陰田。〔俱定公十年〕
夏，叔孫豹會晉趙武、楚屈建、蔡公孫歸生、衛石惡、陳孔奐、鄭良霄、許人、曹人于宋。
translation_en:
Book of Odes

Raise that rhinoceros-horn goblet: may you live ten thousand years, without end!

They campaigned against the Xianyun; the Man of Jing came in submission to their might.

Resplendent is that River of Clouds, forming a pattern in heaven. May the king of Zhou enjoy long life; why should he not nurture worthy men?

Carved and polished is his outward refinement; gold and jade are his substance. Unremittingly our king orders and governs the four quarters.

He conciliates the hundred spirits, including those of the Yellow River and the lofty mountains.

Spring and Autumn Annals

In autumn, in the ninth month, the Marquis of Qi, the Duke of Song, and representatives of Jiang and Huang concluded a covenant at Guan. 〔Second year of Duke Xi.〕

In the ninth month, the Marquis of Jin, the Duke of Song, the Marquis of Wei, the Earl of Zheng, and the Earl of Cao met at Hu. Xun Linfu of Jin led an army against Chen. 〔Ninth year of Duke Xuan.〕

In autumn, in the seventh month, the Marquis of Qi sent Guo Zuo to the army’s encampment. On the jiyou day, a covenant was concluded with Guo Zuo at Yuanlou. 〔Second year of Duke Cheng.〕 In summer, the duke met the Marquis of Qi at Jiagu. The duke returned from Jiagu. The people of Qi came to restore the lands of Yun, Huan, and Guiyin. 〔All in the tenth year of Duke Ding.〕

In summer, Shusun Bao met Zhao Wu of Jin, Qu Jian of Chu, Gongsun Guisheng of Cai, Shi E of Wei, Kong Huan of Chen, Liang Xiao of Zheng, and representatives of Xu and Cao at Song…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
襄公二十有七年叔孫豹會晉趙武楚
公子圍齊國弱宋向戌衛齊惡陳公子
招蔡公孫歸生鄭罕虎許人曹人于虢
昭公元年
禮記
黍曰薌合粱曰薌萁稷曰明粢稻曰嘉蔬
禮樂皆得謂之有德德者得也
事君先資其言拜自獻其身以成其信
溫良者仁之本也敬愼者仁之地也寬裕
===
者仁之作也孫接者仁之能也禮節者
仁之貌也言談者仁之文也歌樂者仁
之和也分散者仁之施也儒皆兼此而
有之猶且不敢言仁也其尊讓有如此
者
第貳場
論
聖神繼天立極
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
punctuated:
襄公二十有七年。叔孫豹會晉趙武、楚公子圍、齊國弱、宋向戌、衛齊惡、陳公子招、蔡公孫歸生、鄭罕虎、許人、曹人于虢。昭公元年。

禮記
黍曰薌合，粱曰薌萁，稷曰明粢，稻曰嘉蔬。
禮樂皆得，謂之有德；德者，得也。
事君，先資其言，拜自獻其身，以成其信。
溫良者，仁之本也；敬愼者，仁之地也；寬裕者，仁之作也；孫接者，仁之能也；禮節者，仁之貌也；言談者，仁之文也；歌樂者，仁之和也；分散者，仁之施也。儒皆兼此而有之，猶且不敢言仁也。其尊讓有如此者。

第貳場
論
聖神繼天立極。
詔誥表〔內科一道〕
translation_en:
…the twenty-seventh year of Duke Xiang’s reign.
Shusun Bao met at Guo with Zhao Wu of Jin, Prince Wei of Chu, Guo Ruo of Qi, Xiang Xu of Song, Qi E of Wei, Prince Zhao of Chen, Gongsun Guisheng of Cai, Han Hu of Zheng, and representatives of Xu and Cao. The first year of Duke Zhao’s reign.

Book of Rites (Liji)
Millet is called “fragrant union”; fine millet, “fragrant stalks”; common millet, “bright grain”; and rice, “fine vegetable.”
To have attained both ritual and music is called possessing virtue. Virtue (de) means attainment (de).
In serving a ruler, first offer one’s words, then bow and dedicate oneself [?], thereby making good one’s trustworthiness.
Gentleness and goodness are the root of benevolence; reverence and caution are its foundation; generosity and magnanimity are its expression in action; humility in dealing with others is its capacity; ritual observances are its outward appearance; speech and conversation are its refinement; singing and music are its harmony; distributing one’s resources is its beneficence. The Confucian scholar possesses all these together, yet still does not dare claim benevolence. Such is his reverence and deference.

Second Session
Discourse
The sage and divine ruler succeeds Heaven and establishes the supreme standard.
Imperial Edicts, Proclamations, and Memorials 〔One question from among these [?]〕

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
擬漢開籍田詔〔文帝二年〕
擬唐以左光祿大夫陳叔達爲禮部尚書
誥〔貞觀六年〕
擬宋以文彦博富弼平章事翰林學士歐
陽脩賀表〔至和二年〕
判語〔五條〕
官員襲廕
別籍異財
禁止迎送
===
擅調官軍
帶造段疋
第參場
策〔五道〕
問稽古益賛堯曰乃聖乃神乃武乃文孔
子曰惟天爲大惟堯則之而史臣之叙
典也首之以欽堯之命舜也在允執其
中一言不知所謂欽與執中者果足盡
堯之大歟堯得統於天嗣是聖人之得
punctuated:
擬漢開籍田詔〔文帝二年〕。
擬唐以左光祿大夫陳叔達爲禮部尚書誥〔貞觀六年〕。
擬宋以文彦博、富弼平章事，翰林學士歐陽脩賀表〔至和二年〕。
判語〔五條〕：官員襲廕；別籍異財；禁止迎送；擅調官軍；帶造段疋。
第參場
策〔五道〕
問：稽古，益賛堯曰：「乃聖乃神，乃武乃文。」孔子曰：「惟天爲大，惟堯則之。」而史臣之叙典也，首之以欽；堯之命舜也，在允執其中一言。不知所謂欽與執中者，果足盡堯之大歟？堯得統於天，嗣是聖人之得
translation_en:
Compose an edict in the voice of a Han emperor inaugurating the imperial ploughing field. 〔Second year of Emperor Wen’s reign.〕
Compose a Tang proclamation appointing Chen Shuda, Left Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, as Minister of Rites. 〔Sixth year of Zhenguan.〕
Compose a congratulatory memorial in the voice of the Song Hanlin Academician Ouyang Xiu on the appointment of Wen Yanbo and Fu Bi as Joint Managers of Affairs of State. 〔Second year of Zhihe.〕
Legal judgments 〔five items〕: hereditary succession and protection privileges for officials; establishing separate household registrations and dividing family property; prohibiting ceremonial welcomes and send-offs; mobilizing government troops without authorization; manufacturing additional bolts of silk alongside an assigned quota [?].
Third Session
Policy questions 〔five questions〕
Question: Examining antiquity, we find that Yi praised Yao, saying, “Sagely and spiritually perceptive, martial and cultured.” Confucius said, “Heaven alone is great; Yao alone took it as his model.” Yet when the court historian set forth the Canon of Yao, he began with reverence; and Yao’s charge to Shun rested on the single injunction, “Sincerely hold fast to the mean.” Can what is called reverence and holding fast to the mean truly encompass all of Yao’s greatness? Yao received the succession from Heaven; thereafter, the sages’ receiving …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
統於堯者果不出於欽與執中之外歟
漢唐而下無論已我
太祖開天立極再造華夏其諭侍臣有曰體道
凝神誠一弗二我
成祖定鼎奠基功兼創守其諭侍臣有曰心能
靜虛自然純是天理不知
二聖之旨有符於堯乎否也我
皇上明德統天
聖神文武雖堯莫尚已堯之民且無能名矧為
===
今日之民哉然
御製敬一箴頒在學宮諸士服習久矣不知敬
即堯之所謂欽一即堯之所謂執歟請
揄揚之以觀涵濡
聖化之盛
問宋有名臣言行錄又有道學名臣言行
錄夫名臣一也乃以道學别之豈諸臣
皆於道未有聞歟我
朝先正嘗編為皇明名臣錄或以勳烈樹或
punctuated:
統於堯者，果不出於欽與執中之外歟？漢唐而下無論已。我太祖開天立極，再造華夏，其諭侍臣有曰：「體道凝神，誠一弗二。」我成祖定鼎奠基，功兼創守，其諭侍臣有曰：「心能靜虛，自然純是天理。」不知二聖之旨有符於堯乎否也？我皇上明德統天，聖神文武，雖堯莫尚已。堯之民且無能名，矧為今日之民哉？然御製《敬一箴》頒在學宮，諸士服習久矣。不知敬即堯之所謂欽，一即堯之所謂執歟？請揄揚之，以觀涵濡聖化之盛。

問：宋有《名臣言行錄》，又有《道學名臣言行錄》。夫名臣一也，乃以道學别之，豈諸臣皆於道未有聞歟？我朝先正嘗編為《皇明名臣錄》，或以勳烈樹，或
translation_en:
…who received the succession from Yao: did they indeed remain within the bounds of reverence and holding fast to the mean? We need not discuss the Han and Tang or subsequent dynasties. Our Taizu opened a new era and established the supreme standard, restoring the Chinese realm. In his instructions to his attendant officials, he said: “Embody the Way and concentrate the spirit; be sincere and single-minded, without division.” Our Chengzu established the capital and laid the foundations; his achievements encompassed both founding and preserving the dynasty. In his instructions to his attendant officials, he said: “If the mind can be still and empty, it will naturally be nothing but heavenly principle.” Were the purport of these two sages’ teachings in accord with Yao’s or not? Our reigning emperor’s luminous virtue unites him with Heaven; in sagacity, spiritual insight, civil virtue, and martial prowess, even Yao could not surpass him. Even Yao’s people could find no words to describe him; how much less can the people of today describe our emperor! Yet the imperially composed Admonition on Reverence and Oneness (Jingyi zhen) has been promulgated in the government schools, and you scholars have long studied and practiced it. Is “reverence” precisely what Yao meant by being reverent, and “oneness” precisely what Yao meant by holding fast? Please expound and extol this, so that we may see how fully you have been steeped in the sage emperor’s transforming influence.

Question: For the Song there is a Record of the Words and Deeds of Eminent Ministers, and also a Record of the Words and Deeds of Eminent Ministers of the Learning of the Way. Eminent ministers constitute a single category; why, then, distinguish some by their Learning of the Way? Had all the other ministers never heard of the Way? A former worthy of our dynasty once compiled a Record of Eminent Ministers of the August Ming. Some established their reputations through meritorious achievements, while others…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
以制作張或以文章鳴非不鍇然足矣
近時有摘取十有五人者别為錄名之
曰理學名臣不知其勳烈制作文章之
用與諸臣同乎異也又有惜詮次之尚
遺再加考訂增補命之曰理學名臣重
編不知其去取果能不詭於先哲歟諸
生以尚友為事者願縱言之無讓
問聖人垂教有曰道藝曰文藝學者所習
有曰德業曰舉業脩德業者以文藝為
===
疣贅游舉業者以道藝為迂闊是二者
果不同與抑習之者之自異與子貢曰
夫子之文章可得而聞也夫子之言性
與天道不可得而聞也是果然與而夫
子之自謂則曰文不在茲專言文抑又
何耶
國家以文取士士由側陋而揚于
天子之廷非舉業莫進也將舉德業而棄之耶
抑敝屣舉業逃遯於世而求其所謂德
punctuated:
以制作張，或以文章鳴，非不鍇然足矣。近時有摘取十有五人者，别為錄，名之曰《理學名臣》。不知其勳烈、制作、文章之用，與諸臣同乎異也？又有惜詮次之尚遺，再加考訂增補，命之曰《理學名臣重編》。不知其去取果能不詭於先哲歟？諸生以尚友為事者，願縱言之，無讓。
問：聖人垂教，有曰道藝，曰文藝；學者所習，有曰德業，曰舉業。脩德業者以文藝為疣贅，游舉業者以道藝為迂闊。是二者果不同與？抑習之者之自異與？子貢曰：「夫子之文章，可得而聞也；夫子之言性與天道，不可得而聞也。」是果然與？而夫子之自謂則曰：「文不在茲。」專言文，抑又何耶？國家以文取士，士由側陋而揚于天子之廷，非舉業莫進也。將舉德業而棄之耶？抑敝屣舉業，逃遯於世，而求其所謂德
translation_en:
…others gained prominence through institutional measures, and others won renown through their writings; their achievements were certainly amply distinguished [?]. Recently, someone selected fifteen men and compiled a separate record entitled Eminent Ministers of Neo-Confucian Learning. We wonder whether the contributions of their meritorious deeds, institutional measures, and writings were the same as those of the other ministers or different. Someone else, regretting that the compilation still contained omissions, undertook further examination, correction, and supplementation, calling it Eminent Ministers of Neo-Confucian Learning, Recompiled. We wonder whether its inclusions and exclusions truly do justice to the worthies of earlier times. You students who make it your concern to befriend the ancients through study: please speak freely, without reserve.
Question: In the teachings handed down by the sages, there are what are called the arts of the Way and the literary arts; in what students pursue, there are what are called moral cultivation and examination studies. Those pursuing moral cultivation regard the literary arts as useless excrescences; those engaged in examination studies regard the arts of the Way as impractical and remote. Are these two pursuits truly different, or do those who practice them themselves create the difference? Zigong said: “The Master’s literary accomplishments can be heard about; his statements on human nature and the Way of Heaven cannot be heard.” Was this really so? Yet the Master said of himself: “Does not this culture reside here in me?” Why, then, did he speak exclusively of culture? The state selects scholars through their writing. For scholars to rise from humble obscurity to distinction at the Son of Heaven’s court, there is no route of advancement except examination studies. Are they, then, to discard moral cultivation altogether? Or should they cast off examination studies like worn-out shoes, withdraw from the world, and seek what they call moral…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
業者耶宋儒有言文辭藝也道德實也
篤其實而藝者書之然則不離舉業而
德業固在耶諸生脩德業而游於舉業
必能言同異之分得失之辨也其詳以
告我
問大學一書儒者脩已治人之道且於此
矣孔子著之而爲經曾氏門人又以其
所聞而爲之傳可謂粲然明備不知於
詩書所載亦有同歟一貫之傳曾子獨
===
得其宗而又以忠恕發之於此其有合
歟否歟傳至於宋程子爲之表章朱子
作爲章句而又補格物致知之傳以嘉
惠後學可謂有功於是書矣而或者乃
謂其傳初未嘗亡特雜見於經傳中其
信然歟果如其說豈朱子顧無見於此
歟嗣後眞西山作大學衍義我
朝丘文莊又爲衍義補益加詳焉二家之言
可以羽翼是學否歟諸士誦習有年必
punctuated:
業者耶？宋儒有言：「文辭，藝也；道德，實也。篤其實，而藝者書之。」然則不離舉業，而德業固在耶？諸生脩德業而游於舉業，必能言同異之分、得失之辨也。其詳以告我。
問：大學一書，儒者脩已治人之道且於此矣。孔子著之而爲經，曾氏門人又以其所聞而爲之傳，可謂粲然明備。不知於詩書所載亦有同歟？一貫之傳，曾子獨得其宗，而又以忠恕發之，於此其有合歟，否歟？傳至於宋，程子爲之表章，朱子作爲章句，而又補格物致知之傳，以嘉惠後學，可謂有功於是書矣。而或者乃謂其傳初未嘗亡，特雜見於經傳中，其信然歟？果如其說，豈朱子顧無見於此歟？嗣後眞西山作大學衍義，我朝丘文莊又爲衍義補，益加詳焉。二家之言，可以羽翼是學否歟？諸士誦習有年，必
translation_en:
…moral achievement? A Song Confucian said: “Literary expression is an art; the Way and virtue are the substance. Strengthen that substance, and literary art gives it written expression.” Does this mean, then, that moral achievement is already present without departing from examination studies? You students cultivate moral achievement while engaging in examination studies; you must be able to explain where these are alike and different, and distinguish their merits and shortcomings. Tell me in detail.
Question: In the Great Learning, the Confucian way of cultivating oneself and governing others is set out here [?]. Confucius composed its classic text, and the disciples of Master Zeng subsequently made a commentary from what they had heard. It may be called lucid and complete. Yet does it also accord with what is recorded in the Book of Odes and the Book of Documents? In the transmission of the teaching of the single thread running through all, Zengzi alone grasped its essential purport, and explained it through conscientiousness and reciprocity. Does this accord with the Great Learning, or not? When the text was transmitted down to the Song, Master Cheng brought it to prominence, and Master Zhu composed the Chapters and Sentences and supplemented the commentary on investigating things and extending knowledge, generously benefiting later students. He may indeed be said to have rendered a service to this book. Yet some maintain that this commentary was never lost in the first place, but is simply found scattered throughout the classic text and its commentary. Is that truly so? If their claim is correct, could Master Zhu really have failed to perceive this? Subsequently, Zhen Xishan composed the Extended Meaning of the Great Learning, and Qiu Wenzhuang of our dynasty further composed the Supplement to the Extended Meaning, adding still greater detail. Can the writings of these two scholars support and advance this learning, or not? You scholars have recited and studied these works for years, and surely…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
有定論於中矣願悉陳於篇
問錢幣之興所以通有無之用足衣食之
源王者以是阜民而成敎化也上古邈
矣夫自九府之法備於太公輕重之權
通於管仲而後刀布泉貨之夥流及後
世然則泉府外府之所掌與萬室千室
之所藏其詳亦有可聞者歟漢氏以來
隨時變易然要以成務宜民故患重則
鑄榆莢患輕則鑄半兩而逐利之民或
===
積餘贏以稽市物或私鼓鑄以觸法網
不知當時何以制其敝歟或欲以白金
皮幣佐錢之用而法終不行或欲用布
帛及穀廢錢不行而議亦終寢其得失
可知也抑將何以處其中歟議改幣者
欲倣古也而卒致天下之亂爲交會者
非古法也而頗得變通之宜然則古固
不可法歟他如子母輕重之論詳矣而
當時不用七福博禍之諫切矣而明君
punctuated:
有定論於中矣，願悉陳於篇。

問：錢幣之興，所以通有無之用，足衣食之源，王者以是阜民而成敎化也。上古邈矣。夫自九府之法備於太公，輕重之權通於管仲，而後刀布泉貨之夥，流及後世。然則泉府、外府之所掌，與萬室千室之所藏，其詳亦有可聞者歟？漢氏以來，隨時變易，然要以成務宜民。故患重則鑄榆莢，患輕則鑄半兩。而逐利之民，或積餘贏以稽市物，或私鼓鑄以觸法網，不知當時何以制其敝歟？或欲以白金、皮幣佐錢之用，而法終不行；或欲用布帛及穀，廢錢不行，而議亦終寢。其得失可知也，抑將何以處其中歟？議改幣者，欲倣古也，而卒致天下之亂；爲交會者，非古法也，而頗得變通之宜。然則古固不可法歟？他如子母輕重之論詳矣，而當時不用；七福博禍之諫切矣，而明君
translation_en:
…you must have reached settled conclusions in your minds. Please set them out fully in your essays.

Question: Money came into being to facilitate exchange between those who have goods and those who lack them, and to ensure adequate sources of clothing and food. Through it, kings enriched the people and brought about moral transformation. High antiquity is remote indeed. The system of the Nine Treasuries was brought to completion under Taigong, and the techniques of regulating economic balances were mastered by Guan Zhong; thereafter, knife money, spade money, and other currencies circulated in abundance down to later ages. Can you explain in detail what the Treasury for Exchange and the Outer Treasury administered, and what communities of ten thousand or a thousand households held in reserve? Since the Han dynasty, currency has changed with the times, but its essential purpose has been to facilitate affairs and benefit the people. Thus, when excessive weight became a concern, elm-seed coins were cast; when insufficient weight became a concern, half-liang coins were cast. Yet people pursuing profit sometimes accumulated surpluses to hold up goods in the market, or privately cast coins in violation of the law. How were these abuses controlled at the time? Some wished to supplement copper cash with silver-alloy currency and leather currency, but the measures ultimately failed to take effect. Others wished to use cloth, silk, and grain, abolishing the circulation of cash, but this proposal, too, was eventually shelved. Their advantages and disadvantages can be ascertained; but how should a proper balance be struck? Those who proposed changing the currency wished to imitate antiquity, yet ultimately brought disorder upon the realm. Those who introduced jiao and hui paper currencies did not follow ancient methods, yet achieved considerable success in adapting to circumstances. Does this mean that antiquity cannot, after all, serve as a model? Again, the argument concerning ‘mother’ and ‘child’ coins and their relative weights was detailed, yet was not adopted at the time; the remonstrance concerning ‘seven blessings and manifold calamities’ [?] was urgent, yet the enlightened ruler…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
不聴意者二子之言其或有未至者歟
諸士子志於經術宜無所不盡心者今
天下同俗四民樂利而廣右之民顧獨
有幣重之患豪右積滯充棟以專利而
貧者曾不得自名一錢此諸士同室之
憂也其將何以變通之歟願有聞焉以
覘用世之學
punctuated: 不聴。意者，二子之言，其或有未至者歟？諸士子志於經術，宜無所不盡心者。今天下同俗，四民樂利，而廣右之民顧獨有幣重之患。豪右積滯充棟以專利，而貧者曾不得自名一錢，此諸士同室之憂也。其將何以變通之歟？願有聞焉，以覘用世之學。
translation_en: …did not heed it. Might there perhaps have been something inadequate in the words of these two men? You candidates devote yourselves to studying the classics and should therefore give every matter your fullest attention. Today, throughout the realm, customs are shared, and the four occupations enjoy prosperity; yet the people of Guangyou alone suffer from the excessive value of currency. Powerful families hoard money until it fills their houses, monopolizing the profits, while the poor cannot claim even a single coin as their own. This is an affliction within your own household, shared by all you candidates. How, then, might adjustments be made to remedy it? I wish to hear your views, so that I may discern the learning you would bring to the service of the world.

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
第壹塲
四書
如或知爾則何以哉
鄧全策
同考試官敎諭陳批此題聖人示人求志之學作者多支
離可厭獨此作發明聖人本意殆盡而文尤典雅可錄
考試官敎授韓批純雅平正儒者用世之志於
此占之
考試官敎授劉批典雅孔子事道之心此亦可
===
見
聖人擬羣賢之見用因探其所致用焉蓋見用
非難而以致其用者爲難也此聖人之於羣賢
必探其志而發之與昔夫子之在當時每懷乎
濟天下之心而於及門之徒恒願其爲斯世之
用乃因四子之侍而導之使言曰功以志而崇
志因言以宣爾之平居甞以人不吾知爲歉矣
夫不知固不可以求售然有能則豈終於無知
乎誠使譽命上逮上有克知灼見之君舉而加
punctuated:
第壹塲

四書

如或知爾，則何以哉？

鄧全策

同考試官敎諭陳批：此題聖人示人求志之學，作者多支離可厭，獨此作發明聖人本意殆盡，而文尤典雅，可錄。

考試官敎授韓批：純雅平正，儒者用世之志，於此占之。

考試官敎授劉批：典雅，孔子事道之心，此亦可見。

聖人擬羣賢之見用，因探其所致用焉。蓋見用非難，而以致其用者爲難也。此聖人之於羣賢，必探其志而發之與！昔夫子之在當時，每懷乎濟天下之心，而於及門之徒，恒願其爲斯世之用。乃因四子之侍，而導之使言，曰：「功以志而崇，志因言以宣。爾之平居，甞以人不吾知爲歉矣。夫不知固不可以求售，然有能則豈終於無知乎？誠使譽命上逮，上有克知灼見之君，舉而加
translation_en:
First Session

Four Books

“If someone were to recognize your abilities, what would you do?”

Deng Quance

Comment by Associate Examiner Chen, Instructor: This topic concerns the learning through which the Sage taught people to pursue their aspirations. Most writers produce treatments that are tiresomely disjointed. This composition alone elucidates the Sage’s original meaning almost completely; its prose is particularly refined and elegant. It merits inclusion.

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: Pure and elegant, balanced and correct. A Confucian scholar’s aspiration to serve the world can be discerned here.

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: Refined and elegant. Confucius’s commitment to serving the Way can also be seen here.

The Sage imagined the worthy disciples being employed in office and therefore inquired into how they would put their abilities to use. For obtaining employment is not difficult; what is difficult is putting one’s abilities to effective use. Surely this is why the Sage felt he must explore the worthy disciples’ aspirations and draw them out!

In his own day, the Master constantly cherished the desire to bring succor to all under Heaven, and he always hoped that those who studied under him would be of service to their age. Thus, when the four disciples were attending him, he guided them to speak, saying: “Achievement is made great through aspiration, and aspiration is expressed through words. In your everyday lives, you have felt dissatisfied that others do not recognize you. Without recognition, you certainly cannot seek an outlet for your abilities; yet if you possess ability, how could you remain forever unrecognized? Suppose that word of your reputation reached those above, and that there were a ruler of discerning understanding and clear insight who would raise you up and confer …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
之於位而相須之意甚殷潜德升聞下有迪知
忱恂之臣引而升之於公而交孚之情彌固斯
時也可以致用之時也爾也非遇不合固不能
先時而有爲見可而出亦不容及時而不爲或
與君協德而精白承休也以資翼爲以資明聽
若何而求以自靖矣乎或與臣協恭而奮庸熈
載也以爲疏附以爲先後若何而期以自見矣
乎際其時之可而用不適焉是速官謗者也子
必不爲也惟其言之浮而實不副焉是貽諾責
===
者也爾尤必不爲也盍各言爾志哉噫吾於是
乎見夫子之善誘矣易之小畜曰君子以懿文
德其大畜曰不家食吉是知古人之學體用合
一畜焉者固以基其發也然三子志於事功而
夫子惟點之與何哉事功濟時也與點樂天也
比而觀之有竝行而不悖者
可以贊天地之化育則可以與天地參矣
馬希燧
同考試官教諭余批作此題者不冗則雜此作詞氣舂
punctuated:
之於位，而相須之意甚殷；潜德升聞，下有迪知忱恂之臣，引而升之於公，而交孚之情彌固。斯時也，可以致用之時也。爾也非遇不合，固不能先時而有爲；見可而出，亦不容及時而不爲。或與君協德，而精白承休也，以資翼爲，以資明聽，若何而求以自靖矣乎？或與臣協恭，而奮庸熈載也，以爲疏附，以爲先後，若何而期以自見矣乎？際其時之可而用不適焉，是速官謗者也，子必不爲也。惟其言之浮而實不副焉，是貽諾責者也，爾尤必不爲也。盍各言爾志哉？噫！吾於是乎見夫子之善誘矣。《易》之《小畜》曰：「君子以懿文德。」其《大畜》曰：「不家食，吉。」是知古人之學，體用合一，畜焉者固以基其發也。然三子志於事功，而夫子惟點之與，何哉？事功，濟時也；與點，樂天也。比而觀之，有竝行而不悖者。
可以贊天地之化育，則可以與天地參矣。
馬希燧
同考試官教諭余批：作此題者，不冗則雜。此作詞氣舂
translation_en:
…to a position in office, with an earnest desire for mutual support; when hidden virtue becomes known above, there are below sincere and trustworthy ministers of discerning understanding [?], who introduce you and advance you at court, making mutual confidence still firmer. Such a moment is a time when you can put your abilities to use. Unless you encounter the right opportunity, you will not enter service; certainly you cannot act before the time is ripe. Yet when you see that circumstances permit and come forward, neither may you fail to act when the time arrives. Perhaps you will join your virtue with your ruler’s and, with pure sincerity, receive his favor, helping to further his actions and enlighten his hearing: how will you seek to discharge your own duty? Or perhaps you will cooperate respectfully with fellow ministers, exerting your abilities and making their undertakings flourish, serving to draw others close and giving assistance before and behind: how will you hope to make your abilities manifest? To encounter a favorable moment yet prove unequal to employment is to invite criticism of one’s conduct in office. You would surely not do this. To make extravagant claims that one’s actual accomplishments cannot fulfill is to incur reproach for one’s promises. Still less would you do this. Why not each state your aspirations?
Ah! Here I see the Master’s skill in guiding others. The Book of Changes says of Lesser Accumulation (Xiaoxu): “The gentleman thereby refines his cultivated virtue.” Of Great Accumulation (Daxu), it says: “Not eating at home: auspicious.” From this we know that in the learning of the ancients, substance and function were united: what they accumulated within was precisely the foundation for its outward expression. Yet the three disciples aspired to practical achievements, while the Master approved only of Dian. Why was this? Practical achievements meet the needs of the age; approval of Dian expresses delight in Heaven. Considered together, these can proceed side by side without contradiction.
“If one can assist the transforming and nourishing work of Heaven and Earth, one can then form a triad with Heaven and Earth.”
Ma Xisui
Comment by Associate Examiner Yu, Instructor: Those who write on this topic are either verbose or confused. In this composition, the language and its force are vigorous [?]…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
發指意詳密善言至誠功化之極致錄之以式
同考試官教諭陳批中庸義作者類始多掇拾獨此
篇說參賛處精切非有養之士不能也
考試官教授韓批晶瑩
考試官教授劉批是善言天人之學者
至誠於造化成其能斯與之準矣夫天地之大
也猶有所不及至誠有以成其能焉寧不與之
準乎中庸推極至誠之功用若此今夫天地化
育其流行賦予於人物者渾然各足也而何言
===
乎至誠之賛之也蓋天地能賦人物以性不能
使之皆盡其性至誠為能盡之則是因心以錫
類凡人物之有憾於天地者胥賴其有相之道
焉範圍曲成而天地於是乎有全功矣脩道以
立教凡天地之有歉於人物者克盡其綏猷之
責焉裁成輔相而造化於是乎有全能矣夫其
賛天地之化育若此寧不可與天地參乎天統
元氣萬物覆焉至誠盡天之所覆而成之其廣
運亦無外矣非髙明配天者耶地統元形萬物
punctuated:
發，指意詳密，善言至誠功化之極致，錄之以式。
同考試官教諭陳批：中庸義，作者類始多掇拾，獨此篇說參賛處精切，非有養之士不能也。
考試官教授韓批：晶瑩。
考試官教授劉批：是善言天人之學者。
至誠於造化成其能，斯與之準矣。夫天地之大也，猶有所不及；至誠有以成其能焉，寧不與之準乎？中庸推極至誠之功用若此。今夫天地化育，其流行賦予於人物者，渾然各足也，而何言乎至誠之賛之也？蓋天地能賦人物以性，不能使之皆盡其性；至誠為能盡之，則是因心以錫類。凡人物之有憾於天地者，胥賴其有相之道焉，範圍曲成，而天地於是乎有全功矣。脩道以立教，凡天地之有歉於人物者，克盡其綏猷之責焉，裁成輔相，而造化於是乎有全能矣。夫其賛天地之化育若此，寧不可與天地參乎？天統元氣，萬物覆焉；至誠盡天之所覆而成之，其廣運亦無外矣，非髙明配天者耶？地統元形，萬物
translation_en:
…resonant in expression, detailed and exact in meaning, and adept at explaining the ultimate achievements and transforming power of utmost sincerity. It is included as a model.
Associate Examiner Chen, an Instructor, comments: In essays on the meaning of the Doctrine of the Mean, writers generally begin with much piecing together of borrowed material [?]. This essay alone explains with precision and insight how one stands alongside Heaven and Earth and assists them. Only a scholar of cultivated character could accomplish this.
Examiner Han, a Professor, comments: Crystalline and luminous.
Examiner Liu, a Professor, comments: This is someone adept at explaining the learning concerning Heaven and humanity.
Utmost sincerity brings the capacities of the creative transformation of nature to fulfillment, and thereby becomes its equal. Great though Heaven and Earth are, there remain things beyond their reach. Since utmost sincerity can bring their capacities to fulfillment, how could it fail to be their equal? Such is the ultimate efficacy that the Doctrine of the Mean attributes to utmost sincerity. Now, in Heaven and Earth’s transforming and nurturing activity, what flows forth and is bestowed upon human beings and other things is an undivided whole, complete in each. Why, then, speak of utmost sincerity assisting them? Heaven and Earth can endow human beings and other things with their natures, but cannot make them all fully realize those natures. Utmost sincerity alone can fully realize them: thus, proceeding from the heart, it extends blessings to others. Wherever human beings and other things have grounds for dissatisfaction with Heaven and Earth, they all depend upon its way of assisting. Encompassing all and bringing each particular thing to fulfillment, it thereby makes the achievement of Heaven and Earth complete. Cultivating the Way to establish instruction, it fully discharges its responsibility to bring order and guidance wherever Heaven and Earth fall short in their provision for human beings and other things. By shaping, completing, supporting, and assisting, it thereby brings the capacities of creative transformation to their fullness. Since it thus assists the transforming and nurturing work of Heaven and Earth, how could it not stand alongside them as a third? Heaven governs primordial vital energy and covers the myriad things. Utmost sincerity brings everything covered by Heaven to full realization and completion; its expansive operation likewise leaves nothing outside it. Is this not matching Heaven in loftiness and luminosity? Earth governs primordial form, and the myriad things…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
載焉至誠盡地之所載而成之其含弘亦無疆
矣非博厚配地者耶天位乎上地位乎下至誠
成位乎其中矣天一以清地一以寧至誠得一
以為貞矣豈可差殊觀哉噫盡性之功斯其至
乎抑性者萬物一源萬物本吾一體故大人所
存必以天下為度而一物失常是亦性分之有
歉也中庸論性徴其効於位育極其功於參贊
非深味一體一源之理不能及之見此者謂之
實理事此者謂之實學
===
欲為臣盡臣道
周希尹
同考試官教諭陳批此題作者類掇套語成篇此作清
新典雅不襲故常他日為臣必能盡道矣
考試官教授韓批足窺孔聖事君之蘊宜錄
以式
考試官教授劉批說盡道處透徹且忠愛之誠
溢於言外
人臣以盡道為心善事君者也甚矣為臣不易
punctuated:
載焉。至誠盡地之所載而成之，其含弘亦無疆矣，非博厚配地者耶？天位乎上，地位乎下，至誠成位乎其中矣。天一以清，地一以寧，至誠得一以為貞矣，豈可差殊觀哉？噫！盡性之功，斯其至乎！抑性者，萬物一源，萬物本吾一體，故大人所存必以天下為度，而一物失常，是亦性分之有歉也。《中庸》論性，徴其効於位育，極其功於參贊。非深味一體一源之理，不能及之。見此者謂之實理，事此者謂之實學。

欲為臣，盡臣道。
周希尹

同考試官教諭陳批：此題作者類掇套語成篇，此作清新典雅，不襲故常，他日為臣，必能盡道矣。
考試官教授韓批：足窺孔聖事君之蘊，宜錄以式。
考試官教授劉批：說盡道處透徹，且忠愛之誠溢於言外。

人臣以盡道為心，善事君者也。甚矣，為臣不易
translation_en:
…are borne by it. The person of utmost sincerity fully realizes and brings to completion all that earth bears; his capacious embrace, too, knows no bounds. Does he not match earth in breadth and depth? Heaven occupies its place above, and earth its place below; the person of utmost sincerity establishes his place between them. Through unity heaven is clear; through unity earth is tranquil; the person of utmost sincerity attains unity and thereby becomes steadfast. How could these be regarded as disparate? Ah! Has the achievement of fully realizing nature not reached its utmost here? Moreover, nature is the single source of all things, and all things are fundamentally one body with me. Thus, what the great man cherishes must take all under heaven as its compass. If even one thing departs from its proper condition, this is also a deficiency in the fulfillment of his own nature. In discussing nature, the Doctrine of the Mean demonstrates its efficacy in heaven and earth taking their proper places and the myriad things being nourished; it carries its achievement to the utmost in joining with heaven and earth and assisting their transforming work. Unless one deeply savors the principle of one body and one source, one cannot attain this. To apprehend this is what is meant by true principle; to put this into practice is what is meant by true learning.

“If one wishes to be a minister, one must fulfill the Way of a minister.”
Zhou Xiyin

Comment by Associate Examiner Chen, Instructor: Those who write on this topic generally assemble stock phrases into an essay. This composition is fresh, refined, and elegant, without following established conventions. When its author becomes a minister in days to come, he will surely be able to fulfill the Way.

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: This affords insight into the profound meaning of the sage Confucius’s service to his ruler. It should be recorded as a model.

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: Its explanation of fulfilling the Way is penetrating and thorough. Moreover, the sincerity of its loyalty and affection for the ruler overflows beyond the words.

A minister who sets his heart on fulfilling the Way is one who serves his ruler well. How very difficult it is to be a minister…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
也而欲盡其道焉非善事君者能之哉孟子將
論人倫當法堯舜此以臣事言之也意謂君之
所賴者臣臣之當盡者道是道也秩之於天則
君尊臣卑所以爲天下之大倫根之於心則委
身事君所以明天下之大義其可以不盡哉茲
欲一日立乎其位必一日業乎其官一日不盡
乎其心若一日不能安乎其位道在於尊主則
以先王之仁心爲必可法益弘吾責難之恭道
宜於庇民則以先王之仁政爲必當行益懋吾
===
陳善之敬天工之委畀者甚殷而精白以承之
者常毅然任天下之重知無不爲不使有一毫
之或歉也職任之付託者甚繁而殫竭以圖之
者常隱然先天下之憂爲無不力不敢有一念
之或遺也分雖等諸天澤而莫踰道則通於乾
坤而無間此臣道所以難盡而不容不盡也歟
雖然道豈待于外哉天之生人物則全具聖人
爲法天下可傳後世固先得人心之同然而卒
未嘗有所加也大禹功底平成可謂天下之大
punctuated: 也。而欲盡其道焉，非善事君者能之哉？孟子將論人倫當法堯舜，此以臣事言之也。意謂君之所賴者臣，臣之當盡者道。是道也，秩之於天，則君尊臣卑，所以爲天下之大倫；根之於心，則委身事君，所以明天下之大義。其可以不盡哉？茲欲一日立乎其位，必一日業乎其官；一日不盡乎其心，若一日不能安乎其位。道在於尊主，則以先王之仁心爲必可法，益弘吾責難之恭；道宜於庇民，則以先王之仁政爲必當行，益懋吾陳善之敬。天工之委畀者甚殷，而精白以承之者，常毅然任天下之重，知無不爲，不使有一毫之或歉也。職任之付託者甚繁，而殫竭以圖之者，常隱然先天下之憂，爲無不力，不敢有一念之或遺也。分雖等諸天澤而莫踰，道則通於乾坤而無間。此臣道所以難盡而不容不盡也歟！雖然，道豈待于外哉？天之生人，物則全具。聖人爲法天下、可傳後世，固先得人心之同然，而卒未嘗有所加也。大禹功底平成，可謂天下之大
translation_en:
…And if one wishes to fulfill this Way completely, can anyone but one skilled in serving his ruler accomplish it? Mencius, about to discuss how human relationships should follow the example of Yao and Shun, speaks here of service as a minister. His meaning is that a ruler depends upon his ministers, and what ministers must fulfill is the Way. Ordered by Heaven, this Way places the ruler above and the minister below, thereby constituting a cardinal human relationship throughout the world. Rooted in the heart, it means committing oneself to serving the ruler, thereby making manifest the great moral obligation of the world. How could one fail to fulfill it completely?

Thus, for every day one occupies one's position, one must attend to the duties of one's office. If for a single day one fails to devote one's whole heart, one should feel unable to rest easy in that position for that day. Where the Way calls for honoring the ruler, one must regard the benevolent hearts of the former kings as models that can assuredly be followed, further enlarging the reverence expressed in demanding difficult achievements of one's ruler. Where the Way calls for protecting the people, one must regard the benevolent government of the former kings as something that must assuredly be practiced, further cultivating the respect expressed in setting goodness before one's ruler.

The work of Heaven entrusted to a minister is exceedingly weighty. Receiving it with purity of purpose, he must always resolutely shoulder the burdens of the world, doing everything he knows ought to be done and allowing not the slightest shortfall. The official responsibilities entrusted to him are exceedingly numerous. Devoting all his strength to their fulfillment, he must always inwardly anticipate the world's troubles, exerting himself fully in everything he undertakes and daring not allow even a single thought to be neglected. Although the distinction in rank resembles that between Heaven and the Lake and cannot be overstepped, the Way pervades Heaven and Earth without separation. Is this not why the minister's Way is difficult to fulfill completely, yet cannot be left unfulfilled?

Nevertheless, how could the Way depend upon anything external? When Heaven gives birth to human beings, the principles governing things are fully present in them. In becoming models for the world whose example can be transmitted to later generations, sages have simply been the first to apprehend what all human hearts acknowledge alike; ultimately, they have never added anything to it. The achievements of Yu the Great brought the earth to order and the waters to tranquility; he may be called the world's great…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
忠矣面從之戒雖舜不能不為禹慮焉况不及
禹者乎故曰不以舜之所以事堯事君不敬其
君者也
易
聖人以神道設教而天下服矣
鄧全策
同考試官教諭陳批神道設教是聖人至德順治之
功此作精深切當而才思充贍宜錄以式
考試官教授韓批講神道設教處精切是宜
錄之
===
考試官教授劉批理順詞新是深於易者錄
之
聖人妙為觀之德有以成天下之順治焉夫聖
人與天為一道也即其所以為觀者何莫非神
之所為哉彖傳極言觀道若此意謂大哉觀乎
天得之以成歲功聖人得之以成治功均不能
外焉者也彼四時不忒固天之所以為觀矣不
有聖人之神道乎基命宥密淵然運萬化於無
punctuated:
忠矣！面從之戒，雖舜不能不為禹慮焉，况不及禹者乎？故曰：「不以舜之所以事堯事君，不敬其君者也。」

易
聖人以神道設教，而天下服矣。
鄧全策

同考試官教諭陳批：「神道設教，是聖人至德順治之功。此作精深切當，而才思充贍，宜錄以式。」
考試官教授韓批：「講神道設教處精切，是宜錄之。」
考試官教授劉批：「理順詞新，是深於易者，錄之。」

聖人妙為觀之德，有以成天下之順治焉。夫聖人與天為一道也，即其所以為觀者，何莫非神之所為哉？彖傳極言觀道若此，意謂：大哉，觀乎！天得之以成歲功，聖人得之以成治功，均不能外焉者也。彼四時不忒，固天之所以為觀矣。不有聖人之神道乎？基命宥密，淵然運萬化於無
translation_en:
…loyalty indeed! Yet even Shun could not help being concerned for Yu over the warning against merely outward compliance. How much more does this apply to those who fall short of Yu! Thus it is said: “One who does not serve his ruler as Shun served Yao does not respect his ruler.”

Book of Changes
“The sages establish their teaching through the numinous Way, and all under Heaven submit.”
By Deng Quance.

Associate Examiner Chen, Instructor, comments: “Establishing teaching through the numinous Way is the achievement of the sages’ consummate virtue in bringing about harmonious order. This composition is profound and precise, with abundant talent and thought. It should be selected as a model.”
Examiner Han, Professor, comments: “The explanation of establishing teaching through the numinous Way is penetrating and precise. This deserves selection.”
Examiner Liu, Professor, comments: “The reasoning is coherent and the language fresh. Here is someone with a profound understanding of the Changes. Select it.”

The sages wondrously realize the virtue of Contemplation (Guan), thereby bringing about harmonious order throughout the world. The sages and Heaven share one Way. In the means by which they present themselves for contemplation, what is there that is not the working of the numinous? The Commentary on the Judgments expounds the Way of Contemplation to this utmost extent. Its meaning is: Great indeed is Contemplation! Heaven attains it and thereby completes the work of the year; the sages attain it and thereby complete the work of governance. Neither can operate outside it. The four seasons’ unfailing regularity is indeed how Heaven presents itself for contemplation. Do not the sages also possess the numinous Way? Establishing the foundations of the mandate in profound stillness, they mysteriously set the myriad transformations in motion within the …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
形凝思穆清亹乎應萬幾而無迹建中自我而
所以錫厥庶民者約之於不見不聞之地表正
自我而所以式是百辟者宰之於何思何慮之
中是其神道設教與天之神道一而已矣初何
心於天下之服也然是神道也發之微妙而不
可見充之周徧而不可窮但見潛孚於道化之
中者聿興夫顒若之仰循習於德教之内者均
切乎媚玆之忱惟欽若焉惟從乂焉自百官以
及萬民莫不丕應而徯志也無淫朋焉無比德
===
焉由畿甸以達要荒靡不丕式而見德也曾有
不服者哉是知天下之服雖由於聖人而所以
服者則本於聖人之神道也天道神而四時順
聖道神而萬民服均不外一觀如此觀之義不
其大哉抑論聖人神道設教固如天之運於上
矣然禮樂刑政所以維持天下之具初未嘗廢
兢業萬幾而天下不見運動之勞何其神也故
曰天地無心成化又曰天地以生物爲心曰聖
人有心無爲又曰大聖人之所作爲嗚呼盡之
punctuated:
形，凝思穆清，亹乎應萬幾而無迹。建中自我，而所以錫厥庶民者，約之於不見不聞之地；表正自我，而所以式是百辟者，宰之於何思何慮之中。是其神道設教，與天之神道一而已矣，初何心於天下之服也？然是神道也，發之微妙而不可見，充之周徧而不可窮。但見潛孚於道化之中者，聿興夫顒若之仰；循習於德教之内者，均切乎媚玆之忱。惟欽若焉，惟從乂焉，自百官以及萬民，莫不丕應而徯志也。無淫朋焉，無比德焉，由畿甸以達要荒，靡不丕式而見德也。曾有不服者哉？是知天下之服，雖由於聖人，而所以服者，則本於聖人之神道也。天道神而四時順，聖道神而萬民服，均不外一觀。如此，觀之義不其大哉？
抑論聖人神道設教，固如天之運於上矣。然禮樂刑政，所以維持天下之具，初未嘗廢。兢業萬幾，而天下不見運動之勞，何其神也！故曰：「天地無心成化。」又曰：「天地以生物爲心。」曰：「聖人有心無爲。」又曰：「大聖人之所作爲。」嗚呼！盡之
translation_en:
…form; concentrating his thought in solemn serenity, he tirelessly responds to the myriad affairs of government without leaving a trace. Establishing the Mean begins with himself, and the means by which he bestows it upon the common people are concentrated in the realm beyond sight and hearing. Setting an upright example begins with himself, and the means by which he provides a model for the many lords are governed within the realm of neither deliberation nor anxious thought. His establishing instruction through the numinous Way is simply one with Heaven’s numinous Way. What deliberate intention did he ever have of securing the submission of all under Heaven? Yet this numinous Way, in its manifestation, is subtle and invisible; in its fullness, it extends everywhere and is inexhaustible. We see only that those inwardly won over by the transforming influence of the Way come to gaze upward in reverence, while those habituated to moral instruction all feel a profound and sincere affection for him. They reverently comply and follow his governance. From the hundred officials to the myriad people, none fails to respond wholeheartedly and await his intentions. There are no unrighteous cliques and no collusion in wrongdoing. From the royal domain to the remotest regions, none fails wholeheartedly to follow his example and manifest his virtue. Could there be anyone who did not submit? Thus we know that although the submission of all under Heaven comes through the sage, what makes them submit is rooted in the sage’s numinous Way. Heaven’s Way is numinous, and the four seasons follow their proper course; the sage’s Way is numinous, and the myriad people submit. Neither goes beyond this single principle of Contemplation (Guan). Is not the meaning of Contemplation, understood thus, great indeed?
Moreover, the sage’s establishing instruction through the numinous Way is indeed like Heaven’s movement above. Yet rites, music, punishments, and government—the instruments by which all under Heaven are sustained—have never been abandoned. He attends to the myriad affairs with reverent diligence, yet all under Heaven see no strain in his activity. How numinous this is! Thus it is said, “Heaven and Earth accomplish transformation without conscious intent.” It is also said, “Heaven and Earth take the generation of living things as their intent.” It is said, “The sage has conscious intent, yet acts without contrivance.” And it is also said, “What the great sage does.” Ah! This says it all…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
矣
是興神物以前民用聖人以此齋戒以神
明其德夫
同考試官教諭陳批齋戒神明其德迺聖人至誠用
以示人不假卜筮而知吉凶也得潔靜精微之旨毋踰此篇
考試官教授韓批易蘊發揮殆盡宜錄之以式
多士
考試官教授劉批易道神妙予亦眞知而善
===
言者
聖人作易以豫民用而因以自妙其用也蓋易
非聖人不能作而亦非聖人莫能用也作之以
利天下而用之其妙若此聖人之於易深矣大
傳專言卜筮至此若曰不假易而知吉凶者聖
人之所以聖也百姓日用而不知易其可無作
乎是故明天道而察民故於是知神物之當興
矣故興蓍以爲筮而得失憂虞之象著凡民志
之所通者由筮以先之也興龜以爲卜而雨霽
punctuated:
矣。

「是興神物以前民用，聖人以此齋戒，以神明其德夫！」

同考試官教諭陳批：齋戒神明其德，迺聖人至誠用以示人，不假卜筮而知吉凶也。得潔靜精微之旨，毋踰此篇。

考試官教授韓批：易蘊發揮殆盡，宜錄之以式多士。

考試官教授劉批：易道神妙，予亦眞知而善言者。

聖人作易以豫民用，而因以自妙其用也。蓋易非聖人不能作，而亦非聖人莫能用也。作之以利天下，而用之其妙若此，聖人之於易深矣。大傳專言卜筮，至此若曰：不假易而知吉凶者，聖人之所以聖也。百姓日用而不知，易其可無作乎？是故明天道而察民故，於是知神物之當興矣。故興蓍以爲筮，而得失憂虞之象著，凡民志之所通者，由筮以先之也。興龜以爲卜，而雨霽
translation_en:
…indeed.

“Thus they brought forth numinous objects to anticipate the people’s needs. Through these the sages purified themselves and observed abstinence, thereby rendering their virtue numinous and enlightened!”

Comment by Associate Examiner Chen, Instructor: Purifying themselves and observing abstinence to render their virtue numinous and enlightened—this is the sages’ utmost sincerity, which they employ to instruct others, knowing good and ill fortune without recourse to turtle-shell or milfoil divination. In grasping the purport of purity, stillness, subtlety, and precision, no essay surpasses this one.

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: The profound meanings of the Changes are expounded almost exhaustively. This should be recorded as a model for the many candidates.

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: The Way of the Changes is numinous and wondrous; I too am one who truly understands it and speaks of it well [?].

The sages made the Changes to provide beforehand for the people’s needs, and through it made their own use of it wondrous. For none but sages could have made the Changes, and likewise none but sages can fully use it. They made it to benefit all under Heaven, yet such is the wondrous character of their own use of it: profound indeed is the sages’ relationship to the Changes. The Great Commentary speaks specifically of turtle-shell and milfoil divination. At this point it seems to say: knowing good and ill fortune without recourse to the Changes is what makes the sages sages. The common people use it daily without understanding it; could the Changes, then, have gone unwritten? Thus, by understanding the Way of Heaven and examining the circumstances of the people, the sages knew that numinous objects must be brought into use. They therefore introduced milfoil for divination, making manifest the images of gain and loss, anxiety and forethought. Whatever the people’s intentions seek to comprehend is anticipated through milfoil divination. They introduced turtle shells for divination, and rain and clearing skies…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
蒙驛克之兆顯凡民疑之所决者由卜以先之
也脩道立教聖人盡有相之道而利用出入天
下被曲成之仁矣而聖人亦豈忘其所有事哉
蓋其吉凶與民同患也致謹於考筮而思慮純
一物不得以雜之至德之淵穆與天載而同神
也致審於稽卜而操存嚴翼欲不得以乘之真
性之昭融與貞明而竝運也易與心涵神以知
來者至是而益見其神動與易會知以藏往者
至是而愈驗其知用之於已既動罔不臧而推
===
之於人復制無不備此聖人所以為易之管而
立天下萬世之人極也與噫學易者能求聖人
之心則於易也幾矣雖然蓍龜神也聖人之所
作亦神也後世顧以卜筮小之何哉傳又不云
乎神而明之存乎其人夫聖人於易曰洗心曰
齋戒學者不求諸心而以用易則於易遠矣故
易心學也學易者必善事其心然後可
書
皇天眷命奄有四海為天下君
punctuated:
蒙驛克之兆顯，凡民疑之所决者，由卜以先之也。脩道立教，聖人盡有相之道，而利用出入，天下被曲成之仁矣。而聖人亦豈忘其所有事哉？蓋其吉凶與民同患也。致謹於考筮，而思慮純一，物不得以雜之，至德之淵穆，與天載而同神也。致審於稽卜，而操存嚴翼，欲不得以乘之，真性之昭融，與貞明而竝運也。易與心涵，神以知來者，至是而益見其神；動與易會，知以藏往者，至是而愈驗其知。用之於已，既動罔不臧；而推之於人，復制無不備。此聖人所以為易之管，而立天下萬世之人極也與！噫！學易者能求聖人之心，則於易也幾矣。雖然，蓍龜神也，聖人之所作亦神也，後世顧以卜筮小之，何哉？傳又不云乎：「神而明之，存乎其人。」夫聖人於易，曰洗心，曰齋戒。學者不求諸心而以用易，則於易遠矣。故易，心學也。學易者必善事其心，然後可。

書
皇天眷命，奄有四海，為天下君。
translation_en:
…the signs of cloudiness, dispersal, and overcoming [?] become manifest. Whatever doubts the people must resolve are thus anticipated through turtle-shell divination. By cultivating the Way and establishing instruction, the sage fully accomplishes the work of assisting transformation; by making their activities beneficial, he enables all under Heaven to receive the benevolence that brings each thing to fulfillment. Yet how could the sage forget his own responsibilities? For he shares the people’s concern over good and ill fortune. Exercising utmost care in consulting the milfoil, he makes his thoughts pure and undivided, so that external things cannot intrude upon them. The profound serenity of his consummate virtue shares the spiritual efficacy of Heaven’s workings. Exercising utmost discernment in examining turtle-shell divination, he preserves his mind with solemn vigilance, so that desires cannot gain purchase upon it. The luminous harmony of his true nature operates together with the constancy and brightness of Heaven and Earth. As the Changes and his mind encompass one another, the spiritual efficacy by which he knows what is to come becomes still more apparent; as his actions accord with the Changes, the wisdom by which he stores up what has passed is still further confirmed. Applied to himself, it ensures that none of his actions is other than good; extended to others, it ensures that his arrangements lack nothing. Is this not how the sage becomes the governing instrument of the Changes [?] and establishes the supreme human standard for all under Heaven through ten thousand generations?

Ah! If students of the Changes can seek the sage’s mind, they will come close to understanding the Changes. Yet milfoil and turtle shells possess spiritual efficacy, and what the sage created likewise possesses spiritual efficacy. Why, then, have later generations belittled it as mere divination? Does the Commentary not also say, “To bring out its spiritual efficacy and make it clear depends upon the person”? In relation to the Changes, the sage speaks of cleansing the mind and of purification and abstinence. If students attempt to use the Changes without seeking understanding within their own minds, they remain far from the Changes. Thus the Changes is a learning of the mind. Only when those who study it attend well to their own minds can they succeed.

Book of Documents

“August Heaven bestowed its favor and mandate upon him; he came to possess all within the Four Seas and became ruler of all under Heaven.”

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
馬希燧
同考試官教諭陳批帝堯盛德得天意發揮明潔
蓋深於經學之士
考試官教授韓批語意精到文法莊重真得伯
益賛帝堯之旨而祗承于帝忠愛之心藹然可見
考試官教授劉批眷命處發揮親切可錄以
式
聖君膺天眷之隆一德之所感也夫惟德動天
也聖君膺天眷而極其隆豈非德之所感哉伯
===
益賛堯因以勉舜之克艱也意謂天人妙感通
之理德福有類應之徵帝也盛德蔑以加矣天
眷其容已乎吾知明德惟馨旣凝昭受之本而
精華旁達足當簡在之求天非私于帝帝有以
克享於天日監在玆保佑而勿替也帝非求于
天天不能庸釋于帝臨下有赫眷顧而無已也
昔也肇封唐土天厚之以有國矣今則奄四海
而有之疆域所蒞九州盡屬于提封壤地所供
五服悉登于貢賦是其羅六合以為家合華夷
punctuated:
馬希燧

同考試官教諭陳批：帝堯盛德得天意，發揮明潔，蓋深於經學之士。

考試官教授韓批：語意精到，文法莊重，真得伯益賛帝堯之旨，而祗承于帝、忠愛之心，藹然可見。

考試官教授劉批：眷命處發揮親切，可錄以式。

聖君膺天眷之隆，一德之所感也。夫惟德動天也，聖君膺天眷而極其隆，豈非德之所感哉？伯益賛堯，因以勉舜之克艱也。意謂天人妙感通之理，德福有類應之徵。帝也，盛德蔑以加矣，天眷其容已乎？吾知明德惟馨，旣凝昭受之本，而精華旁達，足當簡在之求。天非私于帝，帝有以克享於天，日監在玆，保佑而勿替也。帝非求于天，天不能庸釋于帝，臨下有赫，眷顧而無已也。昔也肇封唐土，天厚之以有國矣；今則奄四海而有之，疆域所蒞，九州盡屬于提封；壤地所供，五服悉登于貢賦。是其羅六合以為家，合華夷
translation_en:
Ma Xisui 馬希燧

Comment by Associate Examiner Chen, Instructor: “The idea that Emperor Yao’s abundant virtue won Heaven’s favor is developed with clarity and purity. The writer is evidently deeply versed in classical learning.”

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: “The language and meaning are precise and accomplished, and the composition dignified. It truly captures the purport of Bo Yi’s praise of Emperor Yao; a heart of reverent service to the emperor, loyalty, and affection is plainly manifest.”

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: “The passage on Heaven’s favor and mandate is developed aptly and directly. This may be included as a model.”

That the sage ruler receives Heaven’s favor in its fullness is the response elicited by his undivided virtue. It is virtue alone that moves Heaven. When the sage ruler receives Heaven’s favor in its utmost fullness, how could this be other than a response to his virtue? Bo Yi praised Yao and thereby encouraged Shun to fulfill the difficult duties of rulership. His meaning was that Heaven and humanity have a principle of subtle mutual responsiveness, and that virtue and blessing show evidence of corresponding according to their kind. As for the emperor, nothing could surpass his abundant virtue. How could Heaven’s favor toward him cease?

I know that luminous virtue alone is fragrant: it had already firmly established the foundation for his manifest reception of Heaven’s favor, while its refined brilliance spread in every direction, fully meeting Heaven’s requirements in selecting him. Heaven was not partial to the emperor; the emperor possessed the qualities that enabled him to enjoy Heaven’s blessings. Daily watching over him here, Heaven protected and aided him without interruption. The emperor did not seek favors from Heaven; Heaven could not relinquish the emperor. Looking down in radiant majesty, it favored and cared for him without cease.

Formerly, when he was first enfeoffed in the territory of Tang, Heaven had generously bestowed a state upon him. Now he possesses all within the Four Seas. Throughout the territory under his authority, all Nine Provinces fall within his boundaries; in the contributions supplied by the land, all Five Service Zones furnish tribute and taxes. Thus he embraces the six directions as his home and brings together the Hua and Yi peoples…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
而一統尺地皆其有也何富之至耶昔也初起
唐侯人戴之爲邦君矣今則付天下而君之居
位凝命典禮命討之獨專乘龍御天甸侯要荒
之共撫是其合萬國以朝宗中天地而爲主一
民莫非臣也何尊之至耶吁可以驗大德受命
之不誣矣雖然堯豈無所用其心哉水土之平
親賢之急羲和之命蓋惓惓焉信堯優于克艱
也禹陳謨而舜不自居舜稱堯而益不及舜君
臣都俞吁咈略無一毫滿假之意眞相濟以道
===
也不然舜何愧于堯益豈不知舜哉讀是書者
猶可想見唐虞氣象
山川鬼神亦莫不寧暨鳥獸魚鼈咸若
蔣元倬
同考試官教諭佘批雅純簡切若見聖治之隆也
佳士
考試官教授韓批當時泰和氣象藹然可掬
宜錄以式
考試官教授劉批精瑩疏鬯似知聖化者錄
punctuated:
而一統，尺地皆其有也，何富之至耶！昔也初起唐侯，人戴之爲邦君矣。今則付天下而君之，居位凝命，典禮命討之獨專；乘龍御天，甸侯要荒之共撫。是其合萬國以朝宗，中天地而爲主，一民莫非臣也，何尊之至耶！吁！可以驗大德受命之不誣矣。雖然，堯豈無所用其心哉？水土之平，親賢之急，羲和之命，蓋惓惓焉。信堯優于克艱也。禹陳謨而舜不自居，舜稱堯而益不及舜，君臣都俞吁咈，略無一毫滿假之意，眞相濟以道也。不然，舜何愧于堯，益豈不知舜哉？讀是書者，猶可想見唐虞氣象。

山川鬼神亦莫不寧，暨鳥獸魚鼈咸若。
蔣元倬。

同考試官教諭佘批：雅純簡切，若見聖治之隆也。佳士。

考試官教授韓批：當時泰和氣象，藹然可掬。宜錄以式。

考試官教授劉批：精瑩疏鬯，似知聖化者。錄
translation_en:
…and unite them under a single rule: every foot of land was his. How supreme was his wealth! Formerly, when he first arose as Marquis of Tang, the people upheld him as ruler of their domain. Now all under Heaven was entrusted to him to rule. Occupying the throne and securing the Mandate, he alone held authority over institutions and rites, appointments and punitive expeditions. Riding the dragon and governing Heaven, he cared alike for the royal, lordly, remote, and wilderness domains. Thus he brought the myriad states together to pay homage and stood at the center of Heaven and Earth as their master. Not a single person was other than his subject. How supreme was his honor! Ah! This verifies that the saying that great virtue receives the Mandate is no falsehood.

Yet did Yao have nothing upon which to exert his mind? Bringing the waters and lands into order, urgently seeking intimacy with worthy men, and issuing commands to Xi and He—these were his constant concerns. Truly, Yao excelled in undertaking difficult tasks. Yu presented his counsels, yet Shun claimed no credit for himself; Shun praised Yao, yet Yi made no mention of Shun. In their exchanges of approval and dissent, ruler and ministers showed not the slightest trace of complacency or presumption. Truly, they aided one another through the Way. Otherwise, why should Shun have felt himself inferior to Yao, and could Yi have failed to appreciate Shun? Those who read this book can still envision the spirit of the ages of Tang and Yu.

“The mountains and rivers, ghosts and spirits, were likewise all at peace; birds and beasts, fish and turtles, all lived in harmony.”

Jiang Yuanzhuo.

Comment by Associate Examiner She, Instructor: “Elegant, pure, concise, and pertinent: it is as though one could see the flourishing of sagely government. A fine scholar.”

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: “The atmosphere of supreme harmony in that age is so abundantly present that one could almost gather it in one’s hands. This should be selected to serve as a model.”

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: “Refined and lucid, flowing freely: he seems to understand the transforming influence of the sage. Select…”

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
之
觀聖世氣化之大順可徵其格天矣甚矣達順
之難也聖世之化理無不寧且若焉謂非懋德
以格天也哉伊尹述之以告太甲欲其知取法
也意謂人君以一身為天地神民之主則以一
心為中和位育之原夏王之懋德而罔有天災
也其諸大順之聚矣乎何則山川鬼神皆本造
化以成能者渙而靡萃欲其咸寧難矣茲焉泰
和磅礴乎宇宙而坤德協於安貞嘉氣鬯達乎
===
幽明而百靈同於効順流峙為山川奠其坎止
之常也闔闢為鬼神通乎屈伸之感也未有不
寧者焉是豈有意以徼之哉蓋莫尊如天百神
之所受職而聽命焉者天且弗違況於山川鬼
神乎至若鳥獸魚鼈皆得天地以有生者萬有
不齊欲其咸若難矣茲焉茂對均被于庶彙而
化育為之流行深仁旁及於淵潛而性命為之
各正禽獸居之率其飛走之恒也魚鼈生焉適
其潛泳之機也未有不若者焉是豈有心以鼓
punctuated:
之。

觀聖世氣化之大順，可徵其格天矣。甚矣，達順之難也！聖世之化理，無不寧且若焉，謂非懋德以格天也哉？伊尹述之以告太甲，欲其知取法也。意謂人君以一身為天地神民之主，則以一心為中和位育之原。夏王之懋德而罔有天災也，其諸大順之聚矣乎？何則？山川鬼神，皆本造化以成能者，渙而靡萃，欲其咸寧難矣。茲焉泰和磅礴乎宇宙，而坤德協於安貞；嘉氣鬯達乎幽明，而百靈同於効順。流峙為山川，奠其坎止之常也；闔闢為鬼神，通乎屈伸之感也。未有不寧者焉。是豈有意以徼之哉？蓋莫尊如天，百神之所受職而聽命焉者。天且弗違，況於山川鬼神乎？至若鳥獸魚鼈，皆得天地以有生者，萬有不齊，欲其咸若難矣。茲焉茂對均被于庶彙，而化育為之流行；深仁旁及於淵潛，而性命為之各正。禽獸居之，率其飛走之恒也；魚鼈生焉，適其潛泳之機也。未有不若者焉。是豈有心以鼓
translation_en:
…it.

By observing the great harmony of the transformations of vital energy in a sage’s age, one can verify that his virtue reached Heaven. How difficult it is to attain harmony! Under the transforming governance of a sage’s age, nothing fails to be at peace and in accord. Could one say that this was not achieved by cultivating virtue so as to reach Heaven? Yi Yin recounted this to Tai Jia, wishing him to understand what he should take as his model. His meaning was that, as the ruler in his own person presides over Heaven, Earth, spirits, and people, his single mind is the source of equilibrium and harmony, through which Heaven and Earth take their proper places and all things are nurtured. When the king of Xia cultivated his virtue and there were no calamities from Heaven, was this not the convergence of supreme harmony?

Why so? Mountains, rivers, ghosts, and spirits all derive their powers from the creative transformations of nature. Dispersed and not gathered together, they could hardly all be brought to peace. Yet here supreme harmony filled the universe, and the virtue of Earth accorded with tranquil steadfastness; auspicious vital energy flowed freely through the hidden and visible realms, and the hundred spirits joined in rendering obedience. Flowing waters and towering heights constitute rivers and mountains, settled in their constant patterns of filling hollows and remaining at rest. Closing and opening constitute the workings of ghosts and spirits, communicating through the mutual responses of contraction and expansion. None failed to be at peace. Could this have been deliberately sought? Nothing is more exalted than Heaven, from which the hundred spirits receive their duties and whose commands they obey. If even Heaven did not act contrary to him, how much less would mountains, rivers, ghosts, and spirits do so?

As for birds, beasts, fish, and turtles, all receive life from Heaven and Earth. The myriad beings differ, and it is difficult to bring them all into accord. Yet here his abundant response to Heaven extended equally to every kind of being, so that transformation and nurture flowed freely; his profound benevolence reached even creatures hidden in the depths, so that each attained its proper nature and allotted life. Birds and beasts dwelt there, following their constant ways of flying and running; fish and turtles lived there, freely exercising their capacity to dive and swim. None failed to be in accord. Could this have been a conscious effort to stir …

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
之哉蓋徧覆者天羣生之所資始而竝育焉者
天不愛道況於鳥獸魚鼈乎噫懋德格天之功
章章如是禹吾無間然矣爲嗣王者其可不監
於有夏哉大抵人君代天出治無一非其統理
而感召之機端不容誣帝王因天事天因地事
地山不槎蘗澤不伐夭其用心何至也心和氣
和天地之和應矣伊尹陳戒而拳拳於此其眞
爲老成之愛君也夫
詩
===
稱彼兕觥萬壽無疆
周希尹
同考試官敎諭何批詞婉意足得溫柔敦厚之旨佳士佳士
考試官敎授韓批得詩之肯綮佳士佳士錄之
考試官敎授劉批盛時忠愛之心讀此宛然如見
豳民之愛君必舉酒以祝其壽焉夫福莫先於
壽也豳人舉酒而以是祝君忠愛抑何至哉周
公追述后稷公劉風化之所由以戒成王及此
意謂君之與民有不可踰之分有不容間之情
punctuated:
之哉？蓋徧覆者天，羣生之所資始而竝育焉者。天不愛道，況於鳥獸魚鼈乎？噫！懋德格天之功，章章如是，禹吾無間然矣！爲嗣王者，其可不監於有夏哉？大抵人君代天出治，無一非其統理，而感召之機，端不容誣。帝王因天事天，因地事地，山不槎蘗，澤不伐夭，其用心何至也！心和氣和，天地之和應矣。伊尹陳戒而拳拳於此，其眞爲老成之愛君也夫！

詩

稱彼兕觥，萬壽無疆。

周希尹

同考試官敎諭何批：詞婉意足，得溫柔敦厚之旨。佳士！佳士！

考試官敎授韓批：得詩之肯綮。佳士！佳士！錄之。

考試官敎授劉批：盛時忠愛之心，讀此宛然如見。

豳民之愛君，必舉酒以祝其壽焉。夫福莫先於壽也，豳人舉酒而以是祝君，忠愛抑何至哉！周公追述后稷、公劉風化之所由，以戒成王。及此，意謂君之與民，有不可踰之分，有不容間之情。
translation_en:
…them? Heaven, which covers all things, is that upon which all living beings depend for their beginnings and in which they are nurtured together. Heaven does not withhold its Way; how much less would birds, beasts, fish, and turtles withhold their response? Ah! So manifest was the efficacy of cultivating virtue and thereby reaching Heaven: “In Yu I can find no fault!” Could a succeeding king fail to take the Xia as his mirror? In general, a ruler governs on Heaven’s behalf. Nothing lies outside his ordering care, and the workings through which his conduct elicits responses cannot be gainsaid. Emperors and kings follow Heaven in serving Heaven and follow Earth in serving Earth. In the mountains they do not cut young shoots; in the marshes they do not cut down immature growth. How profound their solicitude! When the heart is harmonious and vital energy harmonious, the harmony of Heaven and Earth responds. In presenting his admonitions, Yi Yin dwelt earnestly upon this. Surely this was a mature elder’s love for his ruler!

Book of Odes

“Raise that rhinoceros-horn cup: may he live ten thousand years without end.”

Zhou Xiyin

Comment by Associate Examiner He, Instructor: “The language is graceful and the meaning fully expressed. It captures the purport of gentleness and generosity. An excellent scholar! An excellent scholar!”

Comment by Examiner Han, Professor: “He grasps the essential point of the ode. An excellent scholar! An excellent scholar! Select this answer.”

Comment by Examiner Liu, Professor: “Reading this, one seems to see before one’s eyes the loyal affection felt in a flourishing age.”

In their love for their ruler, the people of Bin invariably raised wine to wish him longevity. Of blessings, none takes precedence over long life. The people of Bin raised wine and offered this wish to their ruler: how profound was their loyal affection! The Duke of Zhou recounted the origins of the transforming influence of Hou Ji and Gong Liu in order to admonish King Cheng. At this point, his meaning was that between ruler and people there are distinctions that cannot be overstepped and bonds of affection that admit no estrangement…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
吾人受君之賜弘矣今當穡事告成將何以用
其情耶彼朋酒旣備可以洽上下之交也則取
而酌之以昭媚玆之敬兕觥其觩可以供將享
之具也則酌而獻之以効奉上之誠然亦豈徒
獻其物而無所致其祝哉彼壽定於天人之所
不可必者吾君仁愛潛孚而天心允鑒年所之
多歷其必衍而爲萬年之永乎壽以享福人之
所不易致者吾君昭格有素而純嘏是膺難老
之永錫其必引而爲無疆之筭乎長保其位也
===
長保其祿也君國子民殆將與世運相爲靈長
矣天和其永綏也元神其永固也分土列爵殆
將與天地相爲悠久矣夫惟君惠民必久於其
道而后仁澤沛於無窮惟民仰德必壽享萬年
而后忲冒荷於無替此豳民所以形爲祝願之
詞也其忠愛無已固如是夫抑觀豳之君民之
際忠誠兼至情義藹如其俗至厚矣其所由亦
惟念稼穡之艱難俾民自食其力而已厥後成
王保介噫嘻諸詩宛然先世之風遂致太和在
punctuated: 吾人受君之賜弘矣，今當穡事告成，將何以用其情耶？彼朋酒旣備，可以洽上下之交也，則取而酌之，以昭媚玆之敬；兕觥其觩，可以供將享之具也，則酌而獻之，以効奉上之誠。然亦豈徒獻其物，而無所致其祝哉？彼壽定於天，人之所不可必者，吾君仁愛潛孚，而天心允鑒，年所之多歷，其必衍而爲萬年之永乎？壽以享福，人之所不易致者，吾君昭格有素，而純嘏是膺，難老之永錫，其必引而爲無疆之筭乎？長保其位也，長保其祿也，君國子民，殆將與世運相爲靈長矣；天和其永綏也，元神其永固也，分土列爵，殆將與天地相爲悠久矣。夫惟君惠民，必久於其道，而后仁澤沛於無窮；惟民仰德，必壽享萬年，而后忲冒荷於無替。此豳民所以形爲祝願之詞也，其忠愛無已，固如是夫！抑觀豳之君民之際，忠誠兼至，情義藹如，其俗至厚矣。其所由，亦惟念稼穡之艱難，俾民自食其力而已。厥後成王保介噫嘻諸詩，宛然先世之風，遂致太和在
translation_en:
…We have received abundant bounty from our lord. Now that the harvest is complete, how shall we give expression to our feelings? The paired vessels of wine are ready, enabling those above and below to mingle harmoniously; so we take them and pour the wine, displaying our reverent affection for him. The rhinoceros-horn cup curves upward, ready for use in presenting offerings; so we fill and present it, expressing our sincerity in serving our superior. Yet would we merely present these things without also offering a blessing? Longevity is determined by Heaven and cannot be assured by human effort. But our lord’s benevolence and love exert their influence unseen, and Heaven’s heart truly perceives them. Surely the many years of his life will be extended into an enduring span of ten thousand years! Long life in which to enjoy blessings is not easily attained by human effort. But our lord has long been manifestly able to reach the divine and thus receives great blessings. Surely the enduring gift of freedom from the infirmities of age will be prolonged into a boundless lifespan! May he long retain his position and long retain his emoluments! Ruling his state and cherishing his people as his children, he will surely endure alongside the course of the ages. May Heaven-given harmony forever sustain him, and may his vital spirit remain forever secure! With his allotted territory and noble rank, he will surely last as long as Heaven and Earth.

For a ruler to benefit his people, he must persevere in his Way; only then will his benevolent bounty flow without end. For the people who look up to his virtue, he must enjoy a lifespan of ten thousand years; only then can they receive his sheltering bounty [?] without interruption. This is why the people of Bin gave expression to their feelings in words of blessing. Such indeed was their unceasing loyalty and love! Moreover, consider the relationship between the ruler and people of Bin: loyalty and sincerity reached their fullest expression on both sides, and affection and righteousness flourished. Their customs were profoundly generous. The source of this was simply mindfulness of the hardships of sowing and reaping, and enabling the people to feed themselves through their own labor. Later, the poems associated with King Cheng, the field overseers (baojie), and ‘Ah! Oh!’ (Yixi) [?] vividly preserved the spirit of earlier generations, ultimately bringing supreme harmony into…

title: 嘉靖四十三年廣西鄉試錄
text:
宇宙間謂非得於訓戒之力哉此萬世君臣之
所當法也
倬彼雲漢爲章于天周王壽考遐不作人
追琢其章金玉其相勉勉我王綱紀四
方
吳應科
同考試官敎諭何批善說聖人之心法且體裁整
齊文詞純雅殆異乎諸子之撰也高薦允宜
考試官敎授韓批理趣雋永宜錄之以式多
士
考試官敎授劉批聖人善敎善政發明殆盡
錄之
===
詩人兩興聖人之德有以會王道之全焉夫化
以作人治以統人王道備矣非文王之德之盛
其孰能與於斯哉宜詩人取興而形諸咏歌也
意豈不曰至渙者人之心至神者君之德文王
